shared_elements: rows or bands of small repeated signs
justification: Both are weathered stone monuments bearing shallow relief carving that includes small repeated sign-like motifs and at least one circular disc element, with figures rendered in a flat, frontal-or-profile schematic manner. The decisive differences are format and organisation: A is a flat rectangular slab ruled into strict horizontal registers of dense script with figures confined to a bottom panel, while B is a three-dimensional bulky sculptural block whose motifs follow the contours of the body with no register system at all.
